quality_notes: Exact URL deduplication is not provenance deduplication.
Homepage redirects were rejected as irrelevant; no claims drawn from their unrelated content.
AP page extraction partial, excluded from substantive synthesis.
Automatic YouTube transcript text, not listened audio; misspelled names and lyrics not used as technical facts.
Search-only leads are marked in evidence.json.
No audio downloaded or listened to; no closed-service access bypassed.
stopping_reason: Sufficient contrasting documentary results to evaluate strategy; repeat credit results and other-release gear accounts did not resolve exact recording gaps. Next actions need matched audio, original liner/session records, or new source types.
